crossRefs.note: Ben Hadad the king of Syria gathered all his army together; and there were thirty-two kings with him, with horses and…
They went out at noon. But Ben Hadad was drinking himself drunk in the pavilions, he and the kings, the thirty-two…
Now the king of Syria had commanded the thirty-two captains of his chariots, saying, “Don’t fight with small nor great…
There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against Yahweh.

translations.web: Do this thing: take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their place.
translations.bsb: So do this: Dismiss all the kings from their positions and replace them with other officers.
translations.kjv: And do this thing, Take the kings away, every man out of his place, and put captains in their rooms:
